title: Holyoke’s Eddie’s Furniture is closing after 91 years
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Business The longtime owner cites a slowing economy and drying-up funding for state-supported housing programs.
For 91 years, Eddie’s Furniture has been a place where Massachusetts families could find a couch for the living room, a storage bed, or a dining room table — all at a bargain.
The furniture store, housed in a red barn in Holyoke, has been passed down through four generations of the Hicks family.
